decisions.reason: As a low-risk but visible extension of the firm's full floor-care system, the cleaning soap is easy for management to justify keeping while any weak sales can still be framed as temporary and outweighed by prior launch effort.

This care line sits directly in the firm's aftercare strategy for oiled wood floors, so accumulated commitment and the fit with the announced customer-service direction make management inclined to retain it.

The underlay foam is more peripheral and substitutable than the core flooring lines, but after already pruning one underlay product management is likely to keep this remaining variant to preserve the system offer and defend earlier investment.

The oak parquet line is highly central to the firm's core business, likely absorbed substantial development and commercial resources across several models, and is therefore the product management is most prone to continue defending.
